title: Glasses Prescription Weekly Days Until Expiry Trend
dataSources: Contact lens orders (`contacts:order`), glasses prescriptions (`glasses:prescription`), vision exams (`vision:exam`), and lens replacement logs (`lens:replacement`).
app: Contact lens order exports, glasses prescription records, vision exam logs, and lens replacement reminders ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=glasses:prescription days_until_expiry=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(days_until_expiry) as avg_duration, max(days_until_expiry) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst days until expiry for glasses prescription events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture days_until_expiry on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average days until expiry with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It records whether glasses prescription tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
